checks: Real graphical installation and retained-ISO startup; Actions/toolbar Copy/Paste publishes actual bytes, preserves the source and offers details after successful completion
Rename clears the prior file clipboard under the retained move policy: Paste is disabled, Ctrl+V explains that Copy/Cut is required, and the renamed payload is kept
Cut/Paste moves a native file; guarded single-action Undo restores its original location without changing its contents
Conflicts require a safe review: Escape writes nothing, Keep both creates a separate verified copy, Skip keeps the existing file, and explicit Replace stages/verifies the changed destination
Recycle/Restore retains original location; System mutation commands are visibly disabled and keyboard Cut cannot bypass the storage guard
The actual minimum 500x420 window keeps Actions visible in light and dark; Copy/Cut/Paste/Rename/Recycle/New text/Undo remain reachable without relying on a hidden toolbar
A real native-to-USB create-only export refuses an existing filename with a clear reason and keeps both original source and destination
USB Copy to Downloads uses the same cooperative job and conflict review as Copy/Paste; folders are unavailable, Keep both preserves existing contents, and unsupported USB Replace is disabled
A genuine 64-MiB USB import exposes source/destination/verified progress and Cancel; cancellation aborts the unpublished stream, retains the source and leaves accessible completed-result details
USB read-back verified import has the expected independent CRC; cancelling a real native tree copy preserves its only source and reports completed items without claiming full success
Unplugging a source during a genuine USB read stops the generation-bound job, aborts the unfinished destination and preserves previously completed data with an inspectable reason

Independent native metadata/data CRC and full payload comparison verify all confirmed files, while the whole original 1-GiB USB image remains byte-for-byte unchanged; tasks retain zero managed pages/new failures
Two ordinary installed starts retain all independently confirmed data and provide usable Files commands without the ISO
Real 150% and 3840x2160/200% command surfaces keep readable controls, retained storage results and halted idle CPUs

active_progress_damage.scope: Damage rectangles during a running restored transfer, not hardware FPS or physical USB throughput
